back: Contains cell sap (water, sugars, salts) and keeps the cell firm (turgid).

front: Which three structures do plant cells have that animal cells lack?
back: A cellulose cell wall, a large permanent vacuole and (in green parts) chloroplasts.

front: What is inside a bacterial cell?
back: Cell wall, cell membrane, cytoplasm, ribosomes, circular DNA and plasmids; no nucleus, no mitochondria.

front: Key steps in preparing a slide of cells?
back: Thin specimen; add a stain (iodine or methylene blue); lower the coverslip at an angle to avoid air bubbles; view at low power first.
